notes: s009 τά is unrepresented under rule 31: the article governs the expressed head noun ἔθνη, so the relativizer *who* is the participle's helper.
s006 καί takes *even* under rule 82's bare-even arm, no correlative *so* and no *also* being written; καθάπερ keeps a bare *as*.
s010 μή is an ordinary negative on *not*; no negative indefinite stands to absorb it under rules 41 and 59.
